questionEn: Choose the only correct option about “Vitamins”?
choicesEn: Vitamins affect the physical and emotional state of a person.
Organic substances needed by the body in small quantities
Elements necessary for the life of organisms
Organic substances consisting of carbon, hydrogen and oxygen (sugar, etc.)
choicesUz: Vitaminlar insonning jismoniy va hissiy holatiga ta'sir qiladi.
Organik moddalar organizmga oz miqdorda kerak
Organizmlar hayoti uchun zarur bo'lgan elementlar
Uglerod, vodorod va kisloroddan (shakar va boshqalar) tashkil topgan organik moddalar.
explanationEn: Vitamins affect the physical and emotional state of a person.
explanationUz: Vitaminlar insonning jismoniy va hissiy holatiga ta'sir qiladi.
